name: Terrace Kimono
why: Tonal ecru layers over sharp black pleats flatter warm olive skin and read effortlessly Parisian for a terrace that turns into a walk.
avoid: Optic white or sneakers—kills the soft evening line.

name: Marais Dusk Checks
why: Chocolate checks under a navy wool coat give deep-autumn richness while balloon trousers keep the silhouette relaxed for strolling.
avoid: More than one print; the shirt carries the look.
stylist_note: Kimi visual check: MODIFY — tuck the shirt (full or French) so the high waist and D-ring belt talk; sleeves to mid-forearm; brown boots or thin gold chain bridges brown-to-black.

name: Cocoa Suiting
why: A brown slim shirt against grey-marl tailoring is warm, grown, and restaurant-ready, finished with a spritz of the Red Edition.
avoid: Black belt or tie—brown-on-grey is the whole point.

name: Noir sur Noir
why: Monochrome black with three textures—lace-up knit, wool, textured blazer—whispers luxe without a single loud element.
avoid: Any bright accent; restraint is the statement.

name: Pinstripe Architect
why: Off-white texture under the full charcoal pinstripe suit is boardroom-sharp yet soft enough for autumn skin tones.
avoid: The white dress shirt—too icy near the face.

name: Indigo at the Office
why: Dark denim shirt tucked into black pleats under the relaxed blazer nails Parisian creative-office smart-casual.
avoid: Distressed denim; only clean indigo survives here.

name: Crochet After Dark
why: Sheer-textured crochet and barrel denim under a bomber is all black, all attitude, with one warm-metal plaque at the collarbone.

name: Pigalle Layers
why: Grey ribbed tank under the black denim shirt-jacket with studded wide jeans brings streetwear energy that boots ground.
avoid: Keep jewellery to one metal; let the studs be the shine.
stylist_note: Kimi visual check: tank → swap grey for espresso/warm charcoal if it reads ashy (or keep + gold chain); jeans = WEAR, exactly the Paris club silhouette.

name: Canal Saint-Martin
why: Olive henley, relaxed indigo and a denim jacket is the hero-color triple that deep-autumn coloring was built for.
avoid: Don't add a third denim piece; the cap is the casual hook.

name: Brûlé Checks
why: Brown relaxed checks and washed-black denim over indigo jeans feel studied-casual for market runs and long coffees.
avoid: Skip the belt if the jeans sit well; keep it loose.
